'''Marcus Korrin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Con artist/Legends|con artist]] who traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], in search of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. However, he was eventually arrested on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]] on charges of petty theft, and he was incarcerated in the [[Dorthus Tal Prison]]. In a bid to escape, Korrin managed to smuggle out the prison a message that he hoped would make it into the hands of sympathizers of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and persuade them to come and rescue him. Unknown to Korrin, the prison's warden, [[Kedar Blackgate]], detected the message but permitted it to be delivered, so that any attempt to free Korrin could serve as a test of the prison's security.<ref name="CatCW" />
